label: Bible Study
prompt: Beloved, _____ not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verse: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
note: John's simple test — imitate the good, not the evil.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I _____ my God upon every remembrance of you,
verse: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
note: Paul, writing in chains, says every memory of the Philippians makes him thankful.

label: Sunday School
prompt: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the _____ to pray about the sixth hour:
verse: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
note: Peter went up on the housetop to pray, got hungry, and received a vision that was all about food.

label: Deep Water
prompt: So they hanged Haman on the _____ that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
verse: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
note: Haman built a gallows for Mordecai — and the plot ran exactly in reverse.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He that hath pity upon the poor _____ unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verse: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
note: Give to the poor and you're making a loan to the LORD — and Proverbs promises he will pay it back.
